verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ documents a data retention control covering stored learnings and review context, plus a separately controllable model-output logging setting; it also states customer code is never used for model training. However, opting out of all data retention is stated only for self-hosted Enterprise deployments. Missing for 10: explicit user-initiated data deletion/purge workflow, documented retention periods or configurable retention windows on cloud plans, full retention opt-out outside self-hosted Enterprise, independent corroboration.
